job.question: In the Contra Costa County Employees' Retirement Association (CCCERA) April 2018 master custodian RFP, how many copies of the proposal must be submitted, and for how long must the proposal remain a firm and irrevocable offer?
job.expected_facts: One (1) original proposal, four (4) hard copies and one (1) copy in electronic form; the proposal must be a firm and irrevocable offer good for one year from the proposal due date (due 5:00 p.m. PT, Friday, May 25, 2018).
job.acceptance: Accept five paper sets total if the original is clearly included, plus one electronic copy; validity one year from due date. Actual proposal deadline is optional.

prior_reviews.reason: This is a City of Hartford 2024 general investment consultant RFP, not CCCERA’s April 2018 master custodian RFP. Its proposal-copy and offer-duration requirements therefore do not support the requested facts.
quotes: MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT FUND of the CITY of HARTFORD and CITY of HARTFORD OPEB TRUST
REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (“RFP”) GENERAL INVESTMENT CONSULTANT
Four original paper copies of the proposal, and one electronic copy, all fully signed and sealed, shall be submitted to:
A statement to the effect that the proposal is a firm and irrevocable offer, good for five years with two one-year extension options;
Proposals shall be received no later than March 15, 2024 at 5 p.m. Eastern Time (subject to change)
